India-US Trade Talks Focus on Interim Deal Ahead of Potential Modi-Trump Call

Indian Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal was scheduled to meet with US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to discuss the early conclusion of an interim trade agreement between the two countries. The talks come amid a US threat of 100% tariffs this week. While some reports suggest the trade deal is nearing its final stage, others indicate it is not imminent. A potential conversation between Prime Minister Narendra Modi and US President Donald Trump may occur soon.
